value: Reproducible analysis code for lightning mortality at high altitude in the Peruvian Andes, 2017-2024
Codigo de analisis reproducible para la mortalidad por rayos en gran altitud en los Andes peruanos, 2017-2024
Lightning mortality at high altitude exceeds that of Peru's Amazon lowlands despite lower flash density: a nationwide study, 2017-2024
La mortalidad por rayos en gran altitud supera a la de la llanura amazonica del Peru pese a una menor densidad de descargas: estudio nacional, 2017-2024

Reproducible analytical code, metadata, quality-control reports, figures, and non-identifying aggregate outputs for a nationwide geospatial study of lightning mortality in Peru, 2017-2024. Version 2.0.0 imputes censored flash density at the instrument detection limit instead of an arbitrary floor, adds spatial diagnostics, sensitivity specifications and terminal checks as first-class scripts, and expands quality control from 31 to 65 checks. The validated cohort is unchanged.
